LESSON: EASTER LIFE OF JESUS

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The life 3.6 Raising of By the end of the Sub strand, the learner ● Learners to 
Topic 3.7: Easter Life of Jesus

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Easter Life of Jesus. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the events that take place during Easter celebrations
2. appreciate the resurrection of Jesus Christ by taking part in Easter celebrations

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the events that take place during Easter celebrations
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify the events that take place during Easter celebrations. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the resurrection of Jesus Christ by taking part in Easter celebrations
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the resurrection of Jesus Christ by taking part in Easter celebrations. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Easter Life of Jesus.
2. Explain Easter Life of Jesus to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should read the story of Ananias and Sapphira in 1.
4. Show that you can: identify the events that take place during Easter celebrations
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Easter Life of Jesus. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Easter Life of Jesus important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read the story of Ananias and Sapphira in 1.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify the events that take place during Easter celebrations
2. appreciate the resurrection of Jesus Christ by taking part in Easter celebrations

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
